relations.evidence: likhāpayati tat tadā || 1 || pāṭhaḥ || ... likhad vauddhaḥ sasutaḥ suṃdarābhidhaḥ

date.as_written: nepālasaṃvad adriyugāṃkagā || caitrī rākā budhaddinaṃ meṣasaṃkramaṇaṃ yadā

purpose: bhūyāt samṛddhidaṃ rājye maṃtrikule vivṛddhikṛt āyurārogyajananaṃ kṣemakāri ca sarvathā
notes: The colophon notes that this manuscript was copied from an ancient palm-leaf exemplar in Bhujimol script dated NS 480 (catuḥśatādhikāśītyā śrīmannepālahāpane likhitā tāḍapatrīyā bhojismolābhidhā lipiḥ dṛṣṭvā). The present copy was commissioned under Prime Minister Bhimsen Thapa ('janarala-bhīmasena') and supervised by the scholar Padmanidhi in NS 947 (1827 CE).
